mapper.sql: calendar_id, calendar_key, calendar_name, timezone, working_days, date_format(work_start, '%H:%i') as work_start, date_format(work_end, '%H:%i') as work_end, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time

sla_execution_id, deployment_id, process_instance_id, process_definition_id, task_id, task_definition_key, assignee_user_id, status, started_at, reminder_due_at, escalation_due_at, reminders_sent, paused_at, paused_millis, revision
mapper.select: select from wf_business_calendar order by calendar_key
select from wf_business_calendar where status = 'ENABLED' order by calendar_key
select from wf_business_calendar where calendar_id = #{calendarId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into wf_business_calendar (calendar_key, calendar_name, timezone, working_days, work_start, work_end, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{calendarKey}, #{calendarName}, #{timezone}, #{workingDays}, #{workStart}, #{workEnd}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, current_timestamp(3), '', null)
mapper.update: update wf_business_calendar set calendar_name = #{calendarName}, timezone = #{timezone}, working_days = #{workingDays}, work_start = #{workStart}, work_end = #{workEnd}, description = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = current_timestamp(3) where calendar_id = #{calendarId}
update wf_business_calendar set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = current_timestamp(3) where calendar_id = #{calendarId}
mapper.insert:
insert into wf_business_calendar_day (calendar_id, calendar_date, working_day, day_name) values
(#{calendarId}, #{day.calendarDate}, #{day.workingDay}, #{day.dayName})

insert into wf_deploy_task_sla (deployment_id, process_key, task_definition_key, calendar_key, calendar_timezone, working_days, work_start, work_end, calendar_days_json, reminder_minutes, reminder_repeat_minutes, max_reminders, escalation_minutes, escalation_assignee, escalation_event_code, create_by, create_time) values
(#{s.deploymentId}, #{s.processKey}, #{s.taskDefinitionKey}, #{s.calendarKey}, #{s.calendarTimezone}, #{s.workingDays}, #{s.workStart}, #{s.workEnd}, cast(#{s.calendarDaysJson} as json), #{s.reminderMinutes}, #{s.reminderRepeatMinutes}, #{s.maxReminders}, #{s.escalationMinutes}, #{s.escalationAssignee}, #{s.escalationEventCode}, #{s.createBy}, current_timestamp(3))
mapper.select: select deployment_id, process_key, task_definition_key, calendar_key, calendar_timezone, working_days, date_format(work_start, '%H:%i') as work_start, date_format(work_end, '%H:%i') as work_end, cast(calendar_days_json as char) as calendar_days_json, reminder_minutes, reminder_repeat_minutes, max_reminders, escalation_minutes, escalation_assignee, escalation_event_code, create_by from wf_deploy_task_sla where deployment_id = #{deploymentId} and process_key = #{processKey} and task_definition_key = #{taskDefinitionKey}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into wf_task_sla_execution (deployment_id, process_instance_id, process_definition_id, task_id, task_definition_key, assignee_user_id, status, started_at, reminder_due_at, escalation_due_at, reminders_sent, paused_at, paused_millis, revision, update_time) values (#{deploymentId}, #{processInstanceId}, #{processDefinitionId}, #{taskId}, #{taskDefinitionKey}, #{assigneeUserId}, 'ACTIVE', #{startedAt}, #{reminderDueAt}, #{escalationDueAt}, 0, null, 0, 0, current_timestamp(3))
mapper.select: select from wf_task_sla_execution where task_id = #{taskId} for update
select from wf_task_sla_execution where process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} and status = 'ACTIVE' order by sla_execution_id for update
mapper.update: update wf_task_sla_execution set assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}, revision = revision + 1, update_time = current_timestamp(3) where sla_execution_id = #{executionId} and revision = #{revision} and status = 'ACTIVE'

update wf_task_sla_execution set status = 'COMPLETED', paused_at = null, revision = revision + 1, update_time = current_timestamp(3) where sla_execution_id = #{executionId} and revision = #{revision} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'ESCALATED')

update wf_task_sla_execution set reminders_sent = #{expectedOrdinal}, revision = revision + 1, update_time = current_timestamp(3) where sla_execution_id = #{executionId} and revision = #{revision} and status = 'ACTIVE' and paused_at is null and reminders_sent = #{expectedOrdinal} - 1

update wf_task_sla_execution set status = 'ESCALATED', paused_at = null, revision = revision + 1, update_time = current_timestamp(3) where sla_execution_id = #{executionId} and revision = #{revision} and status = 'ACTIVE' and paused_at is null

update wf_task_sla_execution set paused_at = #{pausedAt}, revision = revision + 1, update_time = current_timestamp(3) where process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and paused_at is null

update wf_task_sla_execution set reminder_due_at = date_add(reminder_due_at, interval timestampdiff(microsecond, paused_at, #{resumedAt}) microsecond), escalation_due_at = date_add(escalation_due_at, interval timestampdiff(microsecond, paused_at, #{resumedAt}) microsecond), paused_millis = paused_millis + floor(timestampdiff(microsecond, paused_at, #{resumedAt}) / 1000), paused_at = null, revision = revision + 1, update_time = current_timestamp(3) where process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and paused_at is not null
mapper.insert: insert ignore into wf_task_sla_audit (sla_execution_id, action_type, action_ordinal, actor_user_id, detail, create_time) values (#{executionId}, #{actionType}, #{actionOrdinal}, #{actorUserId}, #{detail}, current_timestamp(3))

insert ignore into wf_task_sla_notification (audit_id, recipient_user_id, action_type, title, content, read_status, create_time) select #{auditId}, cast(u.user_id as char), #{actionType}, #{title}, #{content}, 'UNREAD', current_timestamp(3) from sys_user u where cast(u.user_id as char) = #{recipientUserId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select a.audit_id as auditId, a.sla_execution_id as slaExecutionId, e.process_instance_id as processInstanceId, e.task_id as taskId, e.task_definition_key as taskDefinitionKey, a.action_type as actionType, a.action_ordinal as actionOrdinal, a.actor_user_id as actorUserId, a.detail, a.create_time as createTime from wf_task_sla_audit a join wf_task_sla_execution e on e.sla_execution_id = a.sla_execution_id order by a.audit_id desc limit 500

select n.notification_id as notificationId, n.audit_id as auditId, e.process_instance_id as processInstanceId, e.task_id as taskId, n.action_type as actionType, n.title, n.content, n.read_status as readStatus, n.create_time as createTime, n.read_time as readTime from wf_task_sla_notification n join wf_task_sla_audit a on a.audit_id = n.audit_id join wf_task_sla_execution e on e.sla_execution_id = a.sla_execution_id where n.recipient_user_id = #{userId} order by n.notification_id desc limit 200
mapper.update: update wf_task_sla_notification set read_status = 'READ', read_time = current_timestamp(3) where notification_id = #{notificationId} and recipient_user_id = #{userId} and read_status = 'UNREAD'
mapper.select: select sla_execution_id as slaExecutionId, process_instance_id as processInstanceId, task_id as taskId, task_definition_key as taskDefinitionKey, assignee_user_id as assigneeUserId, status, started_at as startedAt, reminder_due_at as reminderDueAt, escalation_due_at as escalationDueAt, reminders_sent as remindersSent, paused_at as pausedAt, paused_millis as pausedMillis from wf_task_sla_execution order by sla_execution_id desc limit 500
